decision: Reject top-one and dual-model-consensus additive families; no safe recall gain.
method: Features from actual independent native primary-index pools. Case decisions replay either unchanged MiniLM output or a native append packet preview. These are diagnostic/replay evaluations, not 430 production retrieval deployments.

top1.stage: Upper-bound candidate screen only; zero possible gains before packet rendering.

limitations: Synthetic exposed development corpus, with correlated queries per incident.
New no-match judgments are assistant-authored, not independent human precision labels.
Native packet previews and deterministic case replay; no production second model or latency measurement.
No heldout or historical evaluation after development rejection.
No independent upstream E5 numerical-parity reference; pinned graph compatibility only.
The comparator does not judge relevance of every extra record on already answered positive queries.

monotone_threshold_counterexample.explanation: The CORS answer to an HTTP-redirect no-match request exceeds pagination on all three lower-bound gate features, both have unused baseline slots and both append in full. Any monotone lower-bound policy admitting the only observed consensus gain also admits this negative.

e5.export_provenance: Official upstream ONNX artifact, pinned commit and LFS SHA-256.
